notes.title: Patch Notes — Version 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed the amount of resources during runs.
Fixed the correct skills for the Elf and Human factions.
 All buildings now have skill descriptions.

notes.title: Localization Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New art for the main menu.

You can now play the game from the start with all characters.

Fixed localization issues for buildings.
